newsitem.title: UK: Nigeria cuts December crude prices 15-23 cents.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria cuts December crude prices 15-23 cents.

text.p: Nigeria reduced official term crude prices by 15-23 cents for December exports, traders said on Wednesday.
State Nigerian National Petroleum Corp announced December prices down 18 cents for Bonny Light and Qua Iboe at Dated Brent plus 45 cents
Forcados goes down 20 cents for December to Dated Brent plus 50 cents.
Escravos was also cut by 20 cents to Dated Brent plus 40 cents.
Brass River was reduced 22 cents to Dated Brent plus 41 cents.
Pennington was priced down 15 cents at Dated Brent plus 80 cents while Bonny Medium was reduced 23 cents to Dated Brent plus 40 cents.
